_README: External (non-Hotspawn) match-winner lines for the Hotspawn Pick'em slate, collected by session 79a1c6c8.
Every row: decimal odds as displayed by the source page, the bookmaker the source attributes the price to,
the exact page the values were read from, and the UTC capture time. Rows are keyed to the Hotspawn match id
used in data/pickem_inventory.json (the Pick'em page's own server-rendered payload).
status: 'priced' = real two-way market price; 'placeholder' = source's generic 1.8/1.8 default (never used as a line);
'not_found' = no public line located in the checked sources.
De-vigged probability: p_a = (1/odds_a) / (1/odds_a + 1/odds_b)  — computed in pipeline/build_site.py.
source_reading_note: Live markets move. Where the same fixture was read twice, both readings are kept; the later reading is used for the published probability and the drift is shown in the note.

environment_findings.finding: EGamersWorld and HLTV return HTTP 403 to datacenter clients (GitHub Actions runners) while rendering normally in a browser session.
environment_findings.evidence: run 38445055709 'External line probe': all eight EGamersWorld/HLTV URLs answered 403.
environment_findings.consequence: Values above were read in a browser session with an explicit capture timestamp; the CI pipeline collects the fixture inventory automatically and does not attempt to work around the blocks.
